title: HRDA: Context-Aware High-Resolution Domain-Adaptive Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Multi-resolution UDA: a small high-resolution detail crop and a large low-resolution context crop, fused by a learned scale attention.
adaptation: Detail branch at native 512 (or 1024 upsampled); context branch from a 2x downsampled larger view of the module where pool images allow. Only worth running if MIC shows E1 movement.
min_experiment: MIC-E1 + HRDA vs MIC-E1, 3 seeds. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2. Kill if less than +0.02.
evidence: R: GTA->CS 73.8 mIoU (+5.5 over the prior SOTA), Synthia->CS 65.8 (+4.9).
prior_overlap: A 2x input test was n.d. at 4x compute. A multi-res detail/context fusion inside UDA was not tested. Open.

alt_notes.adaptation: Only useful with native-resolution pool sources (about 1200 px): detail crop at native res for cracks, context crop at 512 px for layout.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark entry; score run only if native-res crops are prepared by another direction: HRDA-style dual crop vs PF, kill if test crack IoU gain < +0.012.
